title: Nearly half of Japanese public supports military intervention to defend Taiwan, poll finds
description: Nearly half (48.8%) of Japanese citizens surveyed support military intervention to defend Taiwan if China escalates tensions, while 60.4% advocate for increased military spending. Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi labeled a Chinese invasion of Taiwan a potential “survival-threatening situation,” justifying military action—a departure from Japan’s historically cautious approach. title: Japan says 'communication channels open' after China issues travel warning over Taiwan tensions
description: Japan said “channels of communication are open” with China, a day after Beijing issued a travel warning for its citizens visiting Japan amid rising tensions over Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s remarks on Taiwan.
